title: Notes that overlap on one track play on extra audio tracks inside a group track
description:
As a producer, I want notes that sound together on one track to all play in the set, so that chords, overlapping hits and long tails aren't cut off.

```gherkin
Feature: Notes that overlap on one track
  Scenario: A voiced chord plays on as many audio tracks as it has tones
    Given the pitched track "stab" plays "voicing triad" over the chords "I IV"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the set has a group track "stab"
    And inside it the audio tracks "stab 1", "stab 2" and "stab 3"
    And no two clips on any one of them overlap
    And together they hold every note of "stab"

  Scenario: Only as many audio tracks as needed
    Given the track "hit" plays "at 1 1:3" a sound 3 beats long
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the group track "hit" holds 2 audio tracks

  Scenario: A track whose notes never overlap stays one audio track
    Given the track "horn" loops a 4-beat clip
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then "horn" is one audio track and not a group

  Scenario: The group sits where the track would
    Given the pitched track "stab" is in the group "band"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the group track "stab" is inside the group track "band"
```
